biological.citation: De novo missense variants in phosphatidylinositol kinase PIP5KIγ underlie a neurodevelopmental syndrome associated with altered phosphoinositide signaling. (PMID: 37451268)
biological.summary: Three de novo heterozygous missense variants in PIP5K1C were identified in nine unrelated children with intellectual disability, developmental delay, acquired microcephaly, seizures, and dysmorphic features. The variants cause increased endosomal PI(4,5)P2 production, leading to ectopic recruitment of filamentous actin at early endosomes and dysfunction in early endosome trafficking. A zebrafish model recapitulated the disorder with forebrain, eye, and craniofacial developmental defects.

biological.citation: PIP5K1C phosphoinositide kinase deficiency distinguishes PIKFYVE-dependent cancer cells from non-malignant cells. (PMID: 36803256)
biological.summary: PIP5K1C is required for conversion of PtdIns4P into PtdIns(4,5)P2, and its deficiency in cancer cells underlies sensitivity to PIKFYVE inhibitors. Inhibition of PIP5K1C in WX8-resistant cells transformed them into sensitive cells, while overexpression of PIP5K1C in WX8-sensitive cells increased resistance, demonstrating PIP5K1C's role in lysosome homeostasis, endosome trafficking, and autophagy.

biological.citation: Pip5k1c expression in osteocytes regulates bone remodeling in mice. (PMID: 38495744)
biological.summary: Conditional deletion of Pip5k1c in osteocytes (using Dmp1-Cre) caused low bone mass in long bones and spines, impaired biomechanical properties, reduced type 1 collagen, elevated sclerostin, and reduced focal adhesion protein expression with increased apoptosis. Pip5k1c expression was decreased in osteocytes from senescent and osteoporotic tissues in both humans and mice.

biological.citation: Loss of CDCP1 triggers FAK activation in detached prostate cancer cells. (PMID: 34541033)
biological.summary: The PIP5K1c-201 splicing isoform of PIP5K1C contains a unique SRC phosphorylation site (Y644) and generates local PI(4,5)P2 in detached prostate cancer cells. SRC-mediated phosphorylation of PIP5K1c at pY644 causes a switch of Talin binding from β1-integrin to PIP5K1c, activating the PIP5K1c-FAK complex and promoting anoikis resistance.

biological.citation: EZH2 regulates neuronal differentiation of mesenchymal stem cells through PIP5K1C-dependent calcium signaling. (PMID: 21216957)
biological.summary: EZH2 binds to the promoter region of PIP5K1C to suppress its transcription in proliferating human mesenchymal stem cells (hMSCs). Knockdown of EZH2 enhanced PIP5K1C expression, increasing PI(4,5)P2 and intracellular Ca2+ levels, promoting neuronal differentiation; conversely, knockdown of PIP5K1C reduced PI(4,5)P2 and Ca2+ release, disrupting neuronal differentiation both in vitro and in vivo.

biological.citation: MiR-4649-5p acts as a tumor-suppressive microRNA in triple negative breast cancer by direct interaction with PIP5K1C, thereby potentiating growth-inhibitory effects of the AKT inhibitor capivasertib. (PMID: 37803350)
biological.summary: PIP5K1C was identified as a direct target of miR-4649-5p in triple negative breast cancer cells via whole transcriptome analysis and physical interaction assays. Downregulation or pharmacologic inhibition of PIP5K1C reduced TNBC cell growth, proliferation, and migration, and impacted downstream PI3K/AKT signaling. Combinations of miR-4649-5p upregulation with PIP5K1C or AKT inhibition showed additive growth-reducing effects.

biological.citation: The phosphorylation status of PIP5K1C at serine 448 can be predictive for invasive ductal carcinoma of the breast. (PMID: 30555634)
biological.summary: PIP5K1C phosphorylation at serine 448 (S448) is downregulated in invasive ductal carcinoma compared to normal breast tissue and carcinoma in situ, while overall PIP5K1C expression levels are not indicative of cancer progression. PKD1, the kinase responsible for S448 phosphorylation, is also decreased in invasive ductal carcinoma, suggesting the phosphorylation status of PIP5K1C-S448 serves as a biomarker for breast tumor aggressiveness.

biological.citation: Novel genetic variants of PIP5K1C and MVB12B of the endosome-related pathway predict cutaneous melanoma-specific survival. (PMID: 33163277)
biological.summary: A SNP in PIP5K1C (rs11666894 A>C) was significantly associated with cutaneous melanoma disease-specific survival in a discovery cohort of 858 patients and replicated in 409 patients, with an adjusted hazard ratio of 1.47. eQTL analysis showed that rs11666894 was associated with PIP5K1C mRNA expression levels in lymphoblastoid cell lines from 373 European descendants.

biological.citation: Genetic Association and Expression Analyses of the Phosphatidylinositol-4-Phosphate 5-Kinase (PIP5K1C) Gene in Alcohol Use Disorder-Relevance for Pain Signaling and Alcohol Use. (PMID: 29667742)
biological.summary: Eight SNPs in PIP5K1C were significantly associated with alcohol use disorder in an African ancestry discovery sample. In humanized transgenic mice carrying the OPRM1 A118G polymorphism, acute alcohol exposure significantly upregulated PIP5K1C expression in both the thalamus (p<0.05) and basolateral amygdala (p<0.01) compared to saline-treated controls.
biological.sample_size: 427 AA cases, 137 AA controls; replication N=3,801
biological.significance: p<0.05 after correction (discovery); not significant in replication

biological.citation: Pip5k1c Loss in Chondrocytes Causes Spontaneous Osteoarthritic Lesions in Aged Mice. (PMID: 37008048)
biological.summary: Inducible deletion of Pip5k1c in aggrecan-expressing chondrocytes caused spontaneous osteoarthritis-like lesions in aged (15-month-old) but not adult (7-month-old) mice, including cartilage degradation, subchondral sclerosis, and osteophyte formation. Pip5k1c loss promoted ECM degradation, chondrocyte hypertrophy and apoptosis, and dramatically downregulated focal adhesion proteins including activated integrin β1, talin, and vinculin, impairing chondrocyte adhesion.
